description: Compress PDF. Make a PDF lighter by re-encoding the images inside it. If the result is not meaningfully smaller, you get the original back — untouched. Accepts application/pdf, .pdf; up to 100 MB per file.

grayscale.description: Convert to greyscale. Helps a lot with scans and hurts nothing if there was no colour

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

preset.description: How hard to squeeze. «For screen» is the lightest, «for print» keeps the most detail

name: pdf_compress
